lines.text: Paul says he must go on boasting and speaks of a man caught up to the third heaven fourteen years ago.
The man was caught up to Paradise and heard inexpressible things that he is not permitted to tell.
Paul will boast only in his weaknesses, and to keep him from becoming conceited he was given a thorn in his flesh.
Paul calls the thorn a messenger of Satan and says he pleaded seven times with the Lord to take it away.
The Lord says His power is perfected in glory, so Paul delights in weaknesses, for when he is weak, he is strong.
